fields.description:
Record the architectural decision behind three changes to a committed, shared store format plus a field deletion, so the mixed-version protocol and each rollback boundary are discoverable. Session log 1cb6-d553-6565-49b4 contains the measured facts; do not re-derive them.

## Approach

Create docs/adr/0060-bridge-state-format-changes.md, following the current ADR template and status conventions. docs/README.md already links the docs/adr/ directory and explicitly avoids listing individual ADRs, so preserve that convention and verify the existing directory link rather than editing the index. The ADR will cite the landed A1, A2-1, A3, and A4-2 behavior and describe A2-2 as the cutover that stops legacy writes while retaining mixed-version reads.

## Required content

- A2: last_get_pass relocation to get_rotation.json; A3: scalar baseline normalization; A4-2: prev_snapshot narrowing to a key set; A1: baseline_advanced_at deletion.
- Why bridge state stays committed on the tickets branch: ephemeral GitHub-hosted runners need durable state, and epic 6c9c rejected off-branch relocation.
- The mixed-version protocol: write new plus legacy, read chronological max(new, legacy), then stop and scrub legacy only after direct deployment evidence. Explain why max is required and first-wins is unsafe.
- Prior art: relate this protocol to docs/migrations.md expand/contract migrations, including the committed store-compat fail-closed gate and 352b legacy-mirror retirement, plus epic 6c9c file/ref cutover.
- A2-2 gate: A2-1 merged; successful reconcile-bridge.yml run at a descendant SHA; explicitly refreshed host probe from a descendant build with executable/source recorded and no older process; old/new-writer self-healing oracle. Explain why no pass-record version stamp is available and why direct evidence replaces elapsed time.
- Rollback boundaries: A2-1 reversible; A3 reversible through idempotent read-path canonicalization; A2-2 supports rollback only to A2-1-or-newer; A4-2 requires its recorded forward and reverse corpus evidence.
- Why assignee is excluded from normalization because _assignee_candidates requires its raw shape.
- Measured results: 12.79 KB to 1.74 KB marginal cost after A1, and 218/399 identical prev key sets; cite session log 1cb6-d553-6565-49b4.

## Verification

- Follow an existing accepted ADR structure and use the next available sequential number, 0060 at the reviewed base.
- Add focused documentation tests or deterministic content assertions for every required decision element if an existing ADR check seam exists; otherwise verify exact headings and terms with repository grep.
- Verify docs/README.md continues to link the docs/adr/ directory and that the new ADR is reachable through that directory.
- Run make lint, make typecheck, make test, and repository documentation checks available at execution time.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] [code-verifiable] docs/adr/0060-bridge-state-format-changes.md exists. Tier: file-existence check.
- [x] [code-verifiable] The ADR enumerates A1, A2, A3, and A4-2. Tier: deterministic document-content check.
- [x] [code-verifiable] The ADR explains the mixed-version chronological-max protocol and direct-evidence A2-2 gate. Tier: deterministic document-content check.
- [x] [code-verifiable] The ADR records the rollback boundary for each format change. Tier: deterministic document-content check.
- [x] [code-verifiable] The ADR cites 12.79 KB -> 1.74 KB, 218/399 identical prev key sets, and session log 1cb6-d553-6565-49b4. Tier: deterministic document-content check.
- [x] [code-verifiable] The ADR explains committed-on-branch durability. Tier: deterministic document-content check.
- [x] [code-verifiable] The ADR explains why assignee remains raw. Tier: deterministic document-content check.
- [x] [code-verifiable] The ADR references docs/migrations.md and epic 6c9c as expand/contract prior art. Tier: deterministic document-content check.
- [x] [code-verifiable] docs/README.md retains a resolving link to docs/adr/ without adding an individual ADR entry. Tier: repository link and diff check.

## Files

docs/adr/0060-bridge-state-format-changes.md.

Scope: S. Depends on closed A3 and A4-2.
